prompt:
Hey — I need your help pulling together an official operations brief for our FitHome Pro paid media campaign. We're in the middle of a really messy situation.

Here's the context: we're running ads across three channels (Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads) with the goal of improving purchase ROAS. This week something went wrong — our daily spend jumped significantly, ROAS dropped below where it needs to be, our cost per acquisition is now above the hard limit finance set, and we're seeing issues with how our conversion tracking is firing on Meta and TikTok. The Google side seems healthier. We also have some headline creative variants sitting ready to go but they haven't launched yet.

I need you to read through everything in the `briefs/drafts/` and `ops/` folders in the workspace, make sense of what's happening, and produce a complete, structured campaign operations brief as a file named `campaign_ops_brief.md`.

This brief needs to cover everything — what actions to take on the campaign, what to do with budgets and bids, whether we should launch those creative tests right now, what monitoring rules should be active, and a clear checklist for the media team to follow. Make sure any actions you recommend have clear conditions for reversing them if things get worse.
